sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Fix Google sign-in
Signs in with Google through a web page.
GmsCore support
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Hide ads
Hides the ads and upgrade cards in the Ideas and Community feeds.
Hide upgrade promotions
Hides the Upgrade button, plan banners, subscription card and paywalls. Extra indicators, watchlists, flag colors, alerts, second and tick intervals, and intraday replay are not unlocked.
Unlock multi-chart layouts
Unlocks chart layouts with up to 8 charts on one screen.

sources.label: Preset icon packs, headers and button styles for YouTube and YT Music
sources.author: sahilwasgood
patch_list: Disable analytics
Disables telemetry, screen tracking, and analytics reporting to Firebase and SnowPlow.
Hide ads and upgrade promotions
Hides AdMob ads, GoPro ads in feed, promotional banners in profile and watchlists, and paywall sheets.
Ultimate user badge
Forces the Ultimate badge on the current user profile. Visual only.
Unlock multi-chart layouts
Unlocks chart layouts with up to 8 charts on one screen.
Watchlist Cloud Sync & Manager
Replaces TradingView's watchlist backend with our Cloudflare synced storage directly in the native TradingView watchlist UI.

sources.label: Patches for Morphe.
sources.author: mitrosoft
patch_list: Disable AdMob
Makes the AdMob availability check return false.
Disable analytics
Drops analytics, tracking, and funnel events.
Disable brokers feature
Turns off the brokers feature toggle, which broker trading entry points on charts, watchlist, and alerts check.
Disable GoPro ad fallback
Disables the GoPro promo fallback triggered by AdMob load failures.
Force local Pro plan
Forces the local plan lookup and plan state to report Pro. Also hides the profile upsell banner.
Hide broker UI

Hides broker entry points: the Explore Brokers block, the brokers banner and have-account prompt, the More menu's Trade with your broker button, and the trading and up/down arrows buttons below the chart.
Hide profile upsell banner
Hides the subscription upsell banner below the profile on the Menu tab. Also hidden by Force local Pro plan.
Holy larp
Forces the Ultimate badge on the current user. Visual only.
Strip permissions
Removes the selected permission groups from AndroidManifest.xml.
